qe: How many pairs of letters are there in word 'DIPLOMACY' which have the same number of letters between them as in English alphabetical series?
qh: शब्द 'DIPLOMACY' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने युग्म (pairs) हैं जिनके बीच उतने ही अक्षर हैं जितने कि अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला (alphabetical series) में होते हैं?
e:
Method 1 (Both Directions (Series) Counting Shortcut):
Step 1: 'Alphabetical Series' likha hone par hamesha dono dishaon (Left to Right aur Right to Left) se count karte hain.
Step 2: Left to Right pairs:
- I(9) se aage count karne par: I(9), P(10), L(11), O(12), M(13) → I aur M ke beech 3 letters aate hain, varnamala me bhi 3 aate hain → Pair 1: (I, M).
Step 3: Right to Left pairs:
- C(3) se piche: C(3), A(4), M(5), O(6), L(7), P(8), I(9) → C aur I ke beech 5 letters hain → Pair 2: (C, I).
- M(13) se piche: M(13), O(14), L(15), P(16) → M aur P ke beech 2 letters hain → Pair 3: (M, P).
Step 4: Total pairs $= 1 + 2 = 3$ pairs.
Correct '3' hai.

Method 2 (Positional Difference Method):
Positions: D(4), I(9), P(16), L(12), O(15), M(13), A(1), C(3), Y(25).
- $|\text{Pos}(I) - \text{Pos}(M)| = 13 - 9 = 4$ aur index difference $= 6 - 2 = 4$ (Matched).
- $|\text{Pos}(P) - \text{Pos}(M)| = 16 - 13 = 3$ aur index difference $= 6 - 3 = 3$ (Matched).
- $|\text{Pos}(I) - \text{Pos}(C)| = 9 - 3 = 6$ aur index difference $= 8 - 2 = 6$ (Matched).
Kul 3 pairs bante hain.
Sahi uttar '3' hai.

Exam point: shreni ke pattern ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: How many pairs of letters are there in word 'DIPLOMACY' which have the same number of letters between them as in English alphabetical order?
qh: शब्द 'DIPLOMACY' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने युग्म हैं जिनके बीच उतने ही अक्षर हैं जितने कि अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला क्रम (alphabetical order) में होते हैं?
e:
Method 1 (One-Way / Alphabetical Order Shortcut):
Step 1: 'Alphabetical Order' likha hone par keval Left to Right (A se Z ki taraf) count kiya jata hai.
Step 2: Left to Right count karein:
- D(4) → E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L (No match)
- I(9) → J, K, L, M (Match! I se M ek pair banta hai)
- P(16) → Q, R, S, T, U, V (No match)
- L(12) → M, N, O, P, Q (No match)
- O(15) → P, Q, R, S (No match)
- M, A, C se koi match nahi milta.
Step 3: Keval ek pair (I, M) banta hai.
Correct '1' hai.

Method 2 (Conceptual Clarification Method):
- 'Alphabetical Series' = Forward + Backward (dono dishaayein).
- 'Alphabetical Order' = Forward only (kewal baayein se daayein).
Isliye kewal (I, M) count hoga = 1 pair.
Sahi uttar '1' hai.

Exam point: varnamala ke kram ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'STUDENT' which have the same number of letters between them as in English alphabetical series?
qh: शब्द 'STUDENT' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने जोड़े हैं जिनके बीच उतने ही अक्षर हैं जितने अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला में होते हैं?
e:
Method 1 (Both Directions Counting Shortcut):
Step 1: Positions note karein: S(19), T(20), U(21), D(4), E(5), N(14), T(20).
Step 2: Left to Right pairs:
- S(19) se T(20) → Pair 1: (S, T)
- S(19) se U(21) → Pair 2: (S, U)
- T(20) se U(21) → Pair 3: (T, U)
- D(4) se E(5) → Pair 4: (D, E)
Kul 4 pairs Left to Right prapt hue.
Step 3: Right to Left pairs:
- N(14) se piche count karein: N(14), E(15), D(16), U(17), T(18), S(19) → Pair 5: (N, S).
Step 4: Total pairs $= 4 + 1 = 5$ pairs.
Correct option  5 hai.

Method 2 (Index Distance Verification Method):
- (S, T): $|19 - 20| = 1$, index diff $= 1$
- (S, U): $|19 - 21| = 2$, index diff $= 2$
- (T, U): $|20 - 21| = 1$, index diff $= 1$
- (D, E): $|4 - 5| = 1$, index diff $= 1$
- (N, S): $|14 - 19| = 5$, index diff $= 6 - 1 = 5$
Total $= 5$ pairs.
Sahi uttar '5' hai.

Exam point: shreni ke pattern ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

e:

- D(4) se aage count karein: D(4), I(5), T(6), A(7), T(8), I(9) → Pair 1: (D, I).
Step 3: Right to Left:

- A(1) se D(4) → Pair 3: (A, D)
- A(1) se E(5) → Pair 4: (A, E)

Word me right-side cluster 'E D I T A' aur 'O N' se 4 reverse pairs aur 1 forward pair bante hain: $1 + 4 = 5$.

qe: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'MEDITATION' which have the same number of letters between them as: (ii) In English alphabetical order?
qh: शब्द 'MEDITATION' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने युग्म हैं जिनके बीच उतने ही अक्षर हैं जितने: (ii) अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला क्रम (alphabetical order) में होते हैं?
e:

Step 1: 'Alphabetical Order' me kewal Left to Right dekha jata hai.
Step 2: Left to Right counting:
- D(4) se I(9): D(4) → E(5), F(6), G(7), H(8), I(9) (Match! Distance 5 hai aur letters bhi 5 hain).
- Any kisi akshar se forward count karne par match nahi milta.

Correct '1' hai.

Method 2 (Direct Comparison with Part (i)):
Part (i) me Left to Right se kewal ek pair (D, I) mila tha. Order me piche ki taraf check nahi karte, isliye answer 1 hoga.
Sahi uttar '1' hai.

e:
Method 1 (Comprehensive Letter-Pair Counting Method):

- I(9) se O(15) → Pair 6: (I, O)
- I(9) se P(16) [3rd letter P] → Pair 7: (I, P)
- L(12) se O(15) → Pair 8: (L, O)
- L(12) se P(16) → Pair 9: (L, P)
- O(15) se P(16) [1st letter P] → Pair 10: (O, P)
Step 4: Total pairs $= 3 + 7 = 10$ pairs.

qe: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'COMPUTER' which have the same number of letters between them as in English alphabetical series?
qh: शब्द 'COMPUTER' में अक्षरों के ऐसे कितने युग्म हैं जिनके बीच उतने ही अक्षर हैं जितने अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला में होते हैं?
e:
Method 1 (Bidirectional Alphabetical Counting Shortcut):
Step 1: Positions likhein: C(3), O(15), M(13), P(16), U(21), T(20), E(5), R(18).
Step 2: Left to Right:
- P(16) se T(20): P(16), U(17), T(18) (No), parantu:
- M(13) se P(16): M(13), P(14), U(15), T(16) → Distance 3 hai, par alphabetical diff 3 hai → Pair 1: (M, P).
Step 3: Right to Left:
- E(5) se piche: E(5), T(6), U(7), P(8), M(9), O(10), C(11) (No match).
- R(18) se piche: R(18), E(19), T(20) → Distance 2, $|20 - 18| = 2$ → Pair 2: (R, T).
- P(16) aur O(15) piche ki taraf kramik hain → Pair 3: (O, P).
- O(15) se R(18) piche ki taraf: O(15), M(16), P(17), U(18) (No), parantu R(18) se O(15) index difference 6 hai.
- C(3) se E(5) check karein: C(3), O(4), M(5) (No), C(3) aur E(5) ke beech 5 letters hain.
- Kul valid pairs check karne par 4 pairs prapt hote hain: (M, P), (O, P), (R, T), aur (P, T ya M, O).
Step 4: Total pairs $= 4$.
Correct '6' hai.

Method 2 (Positional Difference Check):
Alphabetical diff = Letter index diff:
- $|\text{Pos}(M) - \text{Pos}(P)| = 3$ aur index diff $= 4 - 3 = 1$ (adjacent)
- Left to right aur right to left mila kar theek 4 pairs banenge.
Sahi uttar '4' hai.

Exam point: shreni ke pattern ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
